name: dev-flow
description: Requirement routing and delivery through issues, CI, review, and merge, with four bundled Matt Pocock skills adapted for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: From requirements to checked and confirmed PR merges.
interface.longDescription: Routes intent and coordinates requirement agreement, specs, tickets, implementation, CI, conditional review, repairs, and merge. Small feature and UI-only changes skip automatic review. Waits for user confirmation of ticket breakdown and final PR merge. Includes four companion skills adapted from a pinned upstream Matt Pocock revision. Project rules remain in AGENTS.md.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-flow for this request. Wait for my confirmation of the ticket breakdown and final PR merge.
